description: Real rights issues and demergers (audit step 2.4). NSE corporate-action records as served by /api/corporates-corporateActions, and raw prices from the NSE bhavcopy (prior session close, ex-date open). Captured 2026-09-30.

kite.note: Kite/raw on 2021-01-01, the only price-scaling action since: our TERP factor matches Kite to 1e-5.

Kite's history implies about 0.9532, i.e. RIL's announced cost-of-acquisition split (4.68 % to JIOFIN). We follow NSE's special pre-open price discovery: 2841.85 - 2580.00 = 261.85, JIOFIN's listing base price on 2023-08-21.
ITC Hotels: 1 share per 10 ITC; 481.60 - 455.60 = 26.00 per ITC share, i.e. about Rs 260 per ITCHOTELS share.
